verdict.rationale: AFK's own docs say a natural-language goal like "Get to $1m ARR" is decomposed by AI into tasks. Each task becomes a directed graph of steps, which amounts to generating a workflow from a prompt. Nothing shows a user editing an existing workflow by prompt, and all evidence is vendor marketing. missing for 10: natural-language editing of existing workflows, documentation of how generated plans can be inspected or modified, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt

citations.quote: Set a goal like "Get to $1m ARR" and AI decomposes it into tasks — revenue modeling, cohort analysis, KPI alerts, milestone tracking — and asks only when it needs a human decision.
Every task becomes a directed graph of steps.
AI plans the steps — revenue modeling, cohort analysis, KPI alerts, and milestone tracking.
